2.text: Add 1 to wound rolls for attacks made with melee weapons by friendly NURGLE DAEMON units.

3.text: Add 1 to wound rolls for attacks made with melee weapons by friendly NURGLE DAEMON units.

rage-embodied.name: Rage Embodied
rage-embodied.text: Add 1 to the Attacks characteristic of LIGHT and HEAVY units whilst they are making Fight actions within 6" of this unit. In addition, LIGHT and HEAVY units cannot make Fall Back moves whilst they are within 6" of this unit.

locus-of-decapitation.name: Locus of Decapitation
locus-of-decapitation.text: Add 1 to hit rolls for attacks made with melee weapons by friendly BLOODLETTER units whilst they are within 8" of this unit.

prey-of-the-blood-god.name: Prey of the Blood God
prey-of-the-blood-god.text: At the start of the first Action phase, you can select one enemy CHARACTER unit. Until the end of the battle, add 1 to hit rolls and wound rolls for attacks made by this unit that target that unit.

psychic-disruption.name: Psychic Disruption
psychic-disruption.text: When your opponent selects a unit within 12" of any units from your army with this ability to manifest a psychic power, before its effects are resolved roll one D6; on a 4+ the effects of that psychic power are not resolved. You cannot use both this ability and the Deny the Witch Command Asset in reaction to the same psychic power.

witness-of-the-past.name: Witness of the Past
witness-of-the-past.text: Once per battle, at the end of the Damage phase, you can look through your Command Asset discard pile, draw the Infernal Gateway Command Asset card and add it to your hand.

visions-of-the-future.name: Visions of the Future
visions-of-the-future.text: Once per battle, at the start of the Action phase, you can look through your Command Asset deck, draw the Gaze of Fate Command Asset card and add it to your hand. Then shuffle the Command Asset deck and place it face down.

rod-of-sorcery.name: Rod of Sorcery
rod-of-sorcery.text: If this unit has a Rod of Sorcery, add 6" to the Range of this unit’s Orange Fires of Tzeentch.

ptarixs-sorcerous-syphon.name: P'tarix's Sorcerous Syphon
ptarixs-sorcerous-syphon.text: When your opponent selects a unit within 12" of this unit to manifest a psychic power, after it is resolved roll one D6; on a 4+, if your opponent has any Command Asset cards in their hand they must select one and discard it.

deluge-of-nurgle.name: Deluge of Nurgle
deluge-of-nurgle.text: When this unit is selected to manifest a psychic power, after resolving its effects roll one D6; on a 4+ place one blast marker next to the closest enemy unit to this unit. If multiple enemy units are equally close, select one and place one blast marker next to it instead.

reverberating-summons.name: Reverberating Summons
reverberating-summons.text: At the start of the Action phase, you can roll one D6 for each friendly LIGHT NURGLE DAEMON unit within 7" of any units from your army equipped with a Doomsday Bell; on a 6+ remove one damage marker from the unit being rolled for.

putrid-offering.name: Putrid Offering
putrid-offering.text: At the start of the Generate Command Assets step, if this unit is equipped with a Bileblade, is a WARLORD and is on the battlefield, you generate one extra Command Asset.

tally-of-pestilence.name: Tally of Pestilence
tally-of-pestilence.text: The Tally of Pestilence starts the battle at 0. At the start of the Action phase, if this unit is on the battlefield add 1 to the tally and look up the result on the chart below. The results are cumulative.

beast-handler.name: Beast Handler
beast-handler.text: If a friendly BEASTS OF NURGLE unit starts a Move action within 6" of this unit, add 3" to that unit’s Move characteristic whilst making that Move action. In addition, add 1 to hit rolls for attacks made by friendly BEASTS OF NURGLE units whilst they are within 12" of this unit.

disease-of-mirth.name: Disease of Mirth
disease-of-mirth.text: When a Morale test is taken for a friendly NURGLE DAEMON unit within 6" of this unit, roll 2D6 and discard one of the results.

jolly-gutpipes.name: Jolly Gutpipes
jolly-gutpipes.text: Add 1 to the Attacks characteristic of NURGLING and GREAT UNCLEAN ONE units whilst they are making Fight actions within 6" of any friendly units with this ability.

stern-taskmaster.name: Stern Taskmaster
stern-taskmaster.text: If a PLAGUEBEARER INFANTRY unit starts a Move action within 6" of any friendly units with this ability, add 2" to its Move characteristic whilst making that Move action.

keep-counting-meet-your-quota.name: Keep Counting! Meet Your Quota!
keep-counting-meet-your-quota.text: Add 1 to hit rolls for attacks made by PLAGUEBEARER units whilst they are within 6" of any friendly units with this ability.

prince-of-chaos-undivided.name: Prince of Chaos Undivided
prince-of-chaos-undivided.text: Re-roll hit rolls of 1 for attacks made by friendly DAEMON units whilst they are within 6" of this unit.

prince-of-chaos.name: Prince of Chaos
prince-of-chaos.text: Re-roll hit rolls of 1 for attacks made by friendly KHORNE DAEMON units whilst they are within 6" of this unit.

prince-of-chaos-2.name: Prince of Chaos
prince-of-chaos-2.text: Re-roll hit rolls of 1 for attacks made by friendly NURGLE DAEMON units whilst they are within 6" of this unit.

prince-of-chaos-3.name: Prince of Chaos
prince-of-chaos-3.text: Re-roll hit rolls of 1 for attacks made by friendly SLAANESH DAEMON units whilst they are within 6" of this unit.

prince-of-chaos-4.name: Prince of Chaos
prince-of-chaos-4.text: Re-roll hit rolls of 1 for attacks made by friendly TZEENTCH DAEMON units whilst they are within 6" of this unit.

sinistrous-hand.name: Sinistrous Hand
sinistrous-hand.text: Each time a blast marker is placed next to an enemy unit as a result of an attack made by this unit with a melee weapon, you can remove one blast marker from this unit. Small blast markers must be removed before large blast markers.

the-eternal-dance.name: The Eternal Dance
the-eternal-dance.text: Add 1 to hit rolls for attacks made with melee weapons by friendly SLAANESH units whilst they are within 6" of this unit.

locus-of-beguilement.name: Locus of Beguilement
locus-of-beguilement.text: Subtract 1 from hit rolls for attacks made with melee weapons by enemy units that target DAEMONETTE units within 6" of this unit.

cloud-of-flies.name: Cloud of Flies
cloud-of-flies.text: If this unit contains 30 models, it is always an obscured target.

slashing-attacks.name: Slashing Attacks
slashing-attacks.text: When this unit finishes making a Move action, select one enemy unit it moved over whilst making that Move action. Roll a number of D6 equal to this unit’s Attacks characteristic, subtracting 1 from each result if that unit is a CHARACTER; for each result of 5+ place one blast marker next to that unit.

sickness-blossoms.name: Sickness Blossoms
sickness-blossoms.text: At the end of the Action phase, the player who set up this terrain feature rolls one D12 if there are any units within 7" of this terrain feature that do not have the NURGLE keyword. On an 8+ place one blast marker next to the closest of those units to this terrain feature; if more than one unit is equally close, the player who set up this terrain feature can choose which of those units to place one blast marker next to.

shroud-of-flies.name: Shroud of Flies
shroud-of-flies.text: LIGHT NURGLE DAEMON units are always obscured targets whilst they are wholly within 7" of any Feculent Gnarlmaw terrain features.

feculent-gnarlmaw.name: Feculent Gnarlmaw
feculent-gnarlmaw.text: After this unit is set up, it is treated as an Obstacle, and is no longer considered to be a unit for any rules purposes.

skull-altar.name: Skull Altar
skull-altar.text: A Skull Altar is a unit that contains 1 model. It cannot be set up on an objective marker and must be set up more than 1" from any other terrain features. After this unit is set up, it is treated as Defensible Terrain, and is no longer considered to be a unit for any rules purposes.

monument-to-slaughter.name: Monument to Slaughter
monument-to-slaughter.text: This terrain feature can only be garrisoned by a single LEGIONES DAEMONICA KHORNE LIGHT INFANTRY CHARACTER unit. Add 1 to the Attacks characteristic of LEGIONES DAEMONICA KHORNE units when making Fight actions within 6" of any Skull Altars that are being garrisoned by a friendly unit.

monarch-of-the-hunt.name: Monarch of the Hunt
monarch-of-the-hunt.text: You can re-roll wound rolls for attacks made with melee weapons by this unit that target CHARACTER units.

formless-horror.name: Formless Horror
formless-horror.text: When this unit makes a Fight action, you can select one enemy Infantry unit in base contact with it. Until the end of that action, this unit’s Weapon Skill characteristic is equal to the selected unit’s.

locus-of-transmogrification.name: Locus of Transmogrification
locus-of-transmogrification.text: Friendly TZEENTCH DAEMON units have the Ignore Damage (6+) ability whilst they are within 9" of this unit.

prince-of-slaanesh.name: Prince of Slaanesh
prince-of-slaanesh.text: Re-roll hit rolls of 1 for attacks made by friendly SLAANESH DAEMON units whilst they are within 6" of this unit.

regal-authority.name: Regal Authority
regal-authority.text: You can re-roll Morale tests taken for friendly SLAANESH DAEMON units whilst they are within 6" of this unit.

horrible-fascination.name: Horrible Fascination
horrible-fascination.text: If an INFANTRY unit within 1" of any enemy models with this ability wishes to Fall Back, the players must roll off. The unit can only Fall Back if the player controlling it wins the roll-off.

harmonic-alignment.name: Harmonic Alignment
harmonic-alignment.text: Once per battle, at the end of the Orders phase, you can look through your Command Asset deck and draw the Denizens of the Warp card. Add the drawn card to your hand, then shuffle the Command Asset deck and place it face down. When that card is used it can only be used to select a friendly LEGIONES DAEMONICA SLAANESH unit that has been destroyed.

blissful-dissonance.name: Blissful Dissonance
blissful-dissonance.text: At the end of the Damage phase, roll one D6 for each LIGHT SLAANESH unit within 6" of this unit. On a 6, remove one damage marker from that unit.

emissary-of-the-blood-god.name: Emissary of the Blood God
emissary-of-the-blood-god.text: Friendly KHORNE units can use this unit’s Leadership characteristic instead of their own whilst they are within 9" of this unit.

whispers-of-madness.name: Whispers of Madness
whispers-of-madness.text: Subtract 1 from the Leadership characteristic of units that do not have the KHORNE keyword whilst they are within 6" of this unit.

emissary-of-the-prince-of-excess.name: Emissary of the Prince of Excess
emissary-of-the-prince-of-excess.text: Friendly SLAANESH units can use this unit’s Leadership characteristic instead of their own whilst they are within 6" of this unit.

emissary-of-the-great-mutator.name: Emissary of the Great Mutator
emissary-of-the-great-mutator.text: Friendly TZEENTCH units can use this unit’s Leadership characteristic instead of their own whilst they are within 9" of this unit.

mantle-of-twisted-fates.name: Mantle of Twisted Fates
mantle-of-twisted-fates.text: When your opponent selects a unit within 12" of any units from your army with this ability to manifest a psychic power, before its effects are resolved roll one D6; on a 4+ place one blast marker next to the unit manifesting the power, and the effects of that psychic power are not resolved. You cannot use both this ability and the Deny the Witch Command Asset in reaction to the same psychic power.

render-of-the-veils.name: Render of the Veils
render-of-the-veils.text: Once per battle, at the end of the Orders phase, you can look through your Command Asset deck and draw either one Legiones Daemonica Command Asset of your choice that is a psychic power, or the Daemonic Ritual, Deny the Witch or Adamantium Will card. Add the drawn card to your hand, then shuffle the Command Asset deck and place it face down.

fel-icon-of-the-tainted.name: Fel Icon of The Tainted
fel-icon-of-the-tainted.text: Re-roll hit rolls of 1 for attacks made by friendly THE TAINTED units whilst they are within 6" of this unit.

poison-slime.name: Poison Slime
poison-slime.text: At the end of the Action phase, roll one D6 for each enemy unit within 6" of this unit; on a 6 place one blast marker next to the unit being rolled for.

exhalations-of-the-plague-pit.name: Exhalations of the Plague Pit
exhalations-of-the-plague-pit.text: Subtract 1 from hit rolls for attacks made with melee weapons by enemy units that target NURGLE and LEGIONES DAEMONICA units within 6" of this unit.

emissary-of-the-plague-god.name: Emissary of the Plague God
emissary-of-the-plague-god.text: Friendly NURGLE units can use this unit’s Leadership characteristic instead of their own whilst they are within 6" of this unit.

daemonic-invulnerability.name: Daemonic Invulnerability
daemonic-invulnerability.text: Each time you roll damage for a LEGIONES DAEMONICA unit in the Detachment, you can roll one D12 for one of that unit's saving throws instead of one D6.

greater-daemon-of-khorne.name: Greater Daemon of Khorne
greater-daemon-of-khorne.text: Friendly KHORNE DAEMON units can use this unit’s Leadership characteristic instead of their own whilst they are within 6" of this unit.

relentless-hunter.name: Relentless Hunter
relentless-hunter.text: You can re-roll hit rolls for attacks made with melee weapons by this unit that target CHARACTER units.

locus-of-khorne.name: Locus of Khorne
locus-of-khorne.text: Add 1 to wound rolls for attacks made with melee weapons by friendly KHORNE DAEMON units whilst they are within 6" of any units with this ability.

greater-daemon-of-tzeentch.name: Greater Daemon of Tzeentch
greater-daemon-of-tzeentch.text: Friendly TZEENTCH DAEMON units can use this unit’s Leadership characteristic instead of their own whilst they are within 6" of this unit.

greater-daemon-of-nurgle.name: Greater Daemon of Nurgle
greater-daemon-of-nurgle.text: Friendly NURGLE DAEMON units can use this unit’s Leadership characteristic instead of their own whilst they are within 6" of this unit.

greater-daemon-of-slaanesh.name: Greater Daemon of Slaanesh
greater-daemon-of-slaanesh.text: Friendly SLAANESH DAEMON units can use this unit’s Leadership characteristic instead of their own whilst they are within 6" of this unit.

locus-of-tzeentch.name: Locus of Tzeentch
locus-of-tzeentch.text: Add 1 to wound rolls for attacks made by friendly TZEENTCH DAEMON units whilst they are within 6" of any units with this ability.

locus-of-slaanesh.name: Locus of Slaanesh
locus-of-slaanesh.text: Add 1 to wound rolls for attacks made with melee weapons by friendly SLAANESH DAEMON units whilst they are within 6" of any units with this ability.

locus-of-nurgle.name: Locus of Nurgle
locus-of-nurgle.text: Add 1 to wound rolls for attacks made by friendly NURGLE DAEMON units whilst they are within 6" of any units with this ability.

gorefeast.name: Gorefeast
gorefeast.text: Each time a blast marker is placed next to an enemy unit as a result of an attack made with a melee weapon by this unit, you can remove one blast marker from this unit. Small blast markers must be removed before large blast markers.

unstoppable-ferocity.name: Unstoppable Ferocity
unstoppable-ferocity.text: Add 1 to wound rolls for attacks made with melee weapons by this unit.

mesmerising-aura.name: Mesmerising Aura
mesmerising-aura.text: Subtract 1 from hit rolls for attacks made with melee weapons by enemy units that target this unit.

psychic-backlash.name: Psychic Backlash
psychic-backlash.text: When your opponent selects a unit within 12" of any units from your army with this ability to manifest a psychic power, before its effects are resolved roll one D12; if the result is equal to or greater than the Leadership characteristic of the unit manifesting the power, place one blast marker next to it. You cannot use both this ability and the Perils of the Warp Command Asset in reaction to the same psychic power.

soporific-musk.name: Soporific Musk
soporific-musk.text: If an INFANTRY unit within 1" of any enemy units with this ability wishes to Fall Back, the players must roll off. The unit can only Fall Back if the player controlling it wins the roll-off.

warp-spines.name: Warp Spines
warp-spines.text: When you select this unit’s Detachment to carry out its order, but before any units in that Detachment make an action (excluding free actions) that phase, roll one D6 for each enemy unit in base contact with this unit. On a 6 place one blast marker next to the unit being rolled for.

might-over-magic.name: Might Over Magic
might-over-magic.text: Add 1 to wound rolls for attacks made with melee weapons by this unit.

ephemeral-form.name: Ephemeral Form
ephemeral-form.text: Add 1 to saving throws made for this unit.

eternal-torment.name: Eternal Torment
eternal-torment.text: At the start of the Action phase, you can remove one damage marker from this unit.

daemonic-master-psyker.name: Daemonic Master Psyker
daemonic-master-psyker.text: Once per battle, at the end of the Orders phase, you can look through your Command Asset deck and draw either one Legiones Daemonica Command Asset of your choice that is a psychic power, or the Daemonic Ritual, Deny the Witch or Adamantium Will card. Add the drawn card to your hand, then shuffle the Command Asset deck and place it face down.
